title: Let saintly company end the mind's pacing
summary: Patience begins when the mind stops roaming and stays in good company. Let honor return to the delay.
takeaway: Let honor return to the delay.
lifeApplication: Before the complaint takes the room, let one quiet line turn waiting toward honor.

source.shortMeaning: Patience begins when the mind stops roaming and stays in good company.
source.lifeApplication: When impatience starts pacing, stay near patient people a little longer.
